metadata.title: Create Step File
metadata.purposeAndUsage: Complete step file with all sections

output.description: Complete step file with all sections

prerequisites: Step design completed (purpose, category, structure, flow diagram)
specificActions: Follow the substeps below in sequence
Workflow: create directory → create JSON file → validate
JSON file contains: all guidance, substeps, tools, dependencies
Reference existing step JSON files in the same category for structure guidance

read: Existing step JSON files in the same category for structure reference

tools: read_file - Read existing step JSON files for structure reference
bestPractices: JSON files contain all step information: guidance, substeps, tools, dependencies
Use clear, actionable descriptions in substeps
ALWAYS pause for user review after creating files - present the created files and ask for approval before proceeding to validation or next steps

approvalCheckpoint.action: Present created files to user for review before proceeding
approvalCheckpoint.reason: User should have opportunity to review generated content before validation

substeps.name: Create category directory if needed
substeps.description: Ensure the category directory exists in ~/.claude/agentic-processes/templates/steps/
actions: Check if ~/.claude/agentic-processes/templates/steps/{category}/ exists
Create directory if it doesn't exist

substeps.name: Create step JSON file
substeps.description: Create the step JSON file with complete guidance and structure
actions: Review 1-2 existing step JSON files in the same or similar category for structure reference
Create file: ~/.claude/agentic-processes/templates/steps/{category}/{step-name}.json
Include metadata: type, name, category, title, purposeAndUsage, lastUpdated
Include output: description, artifacts, memoryUpdates
Include guidance: prerequisites, mandatoryComponents, specificActions, files, tools, bestPractices
Include substeps: array with number, name, description, actions
Include flow: description of flow logic
Include memoryFileUsage: readFrom, writeTo, fields
Include dependencies: requiredComponents, requiredFiles, requiredTools
Include references: relatedSteps, usedInTemplates

substeps.name: Present file for user review
substeps.description: Show created JSON file to user and wait for approval before validation
actions: Present the created JSON file path and key sections
Ask user to review and approve before proceeding
Wait for user confirmation

substeps.name: Validate all sections
substeps.description: Verify the JSON file is complete and well-structured
actions: Verify JSON has all required sections (metadata, output, guidance, substeps, flow, memoryFileUsage)
Verify flow description matches substeps
Document validation results in memory

substeps.name: End-Step: Compliance Check
substeps.description: Verify principles were followed in this step
actions: Verify: Was log.json updated for any user interactions?
Verify: Were mandatory actions confirmed with output?

Log problems: If any problems, errors, workarounds, or unexpected situations were encountered during this step, log them via add-log-entry --problems '["description of problem 1", ...]'. This feeds the continuous-improvement step's analysis.
Output: '✓ Step completed in compliance with operating principles'

flow.description: Linear flow: create directory → create JSON file → USER APPROVAL → validate

fields: Information Produced: JSON file path, validation results
